In algebra, the '''principal factor''' of a <math>\mathcal{J}</math>-class ''J'' of a [[semigroup]] ''S'' is equal to ''J'' if ''J'' is the [[kernel (algebra)|kernel]] of ''S'', and to <math>J \cup \{0\}</math> otherwise.

== Properties ==
* A principal factor is a [[Simple semigroup|simple]], [[0-simple]] or [[null semigroup]].<ref>Grillet (1995), p. 50, Proposition 4.9.</ref>
